215	export async function streamAiChat(
216	  messages: AiMessage[],
217	  system: string | undefined,
218	  onChunk: (text: string) => void,
219	  signal?: AbortSignal,
220	): Promise<string> {
221	  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/ai/stream`, {
222	    method: 'POST',
223	    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
224	    body: JSON.stringify({ messages, system }),
225	    signal,
226	  })
227	  if (!res.ok) {
228	    const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: `HTTP ${res.status}` }))
229	    throw new Error(data.error || `API error: ${res.status}`)
230	  }
231	  const reader = res.body!.getReader()
232	  const decoder = new TextDecoder()
233	  let buffer = ''
234	  let fullContent = ''
235	
236	  while (true) {
237	    const { done, value } = await reader.read()
238	    if (done) break
239	    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true })
240	    const parts = buffer.split('\n')
241	    buffer = parts.pop() ?? ''
242	    for (const line of parts) {
243	      const trimmed = line.trim()
244	      if (!trimmed.startsWith('data: ')) continue
245	      try {
246	        const event = JSON.parse(trimmed.slice(6))
247	        if (event.type === 'chunk') {
248	          fullContent += event.content
249	          onChunk(event.content)
250	        } else if (event.type === 'done') {
251	          fullContent = event.content
252	        } else if (event.type === 'error') {
253	          throw new Error(event.error)
254	        }
255	      } catch (e) {
256	        if (e instanceof SyntaxError) continue
257	        throw e
258	      }
259	    }
260	  }
261	  return fullContent
262	}

## Summary: Org Chart Component & Data Architecture

I've located the complete org chart implementation. Here's what I found:

### 1. **Component File** (React)
- **Location**: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Polyglot/client/src/pages/OrgChart.tsx` (1766 lines)
- **Layout Library**: **React Flow** (from `@xyflow/react`) — lines 3-18
- **Two custom node types**:
  - `OrgLeaderNode` (lines 279-336) — renders "LEADERSHIP"/"ADVISOR" cards at top with crown badges, model badges (Opus/Sonnet), avatars
  - `OrgDepartmentNode` (lines 340+) — renders department columns with member rows

### 2. **Layout Algorithm** (Custom, NOT dagre/elkjs)
- **Function**: `computeDepartmentLayout()` (lines 137-275)
- **Positioning strategy**:
  - Leaders (Rex) centered at top: `y: 0`, x-spacing with `LEADER_WIDTH (260px) + LEADER_LEADER_GAP (64px)` — lines 208-230
  - Departments below leaders: `y: LEADER_HEIGHT (96) + LEADER_DEPT_GAP (90) = 186px` — lines 232-272
  - Departments horizontally spaced: `DEPT_WIDTH (340px) + DEPT_ROW_GAP (36px)` — line 235
  - Edges (orange lines) from Rex to departments: `type: 'smoothstep'`, `stroke: dept.color`, `opacity: 0.55` — lines 259-271

### 3. **Data Source** (Backend)
- **Route**: `/api/org-chart` (GET) — `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Polyglot/src/routes/orgHr.js` lines 28-40
- **Data builder**: `org.buildOrgChart()` — `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Polyglot/src/org.js` lines 160-273
- **Registry source**: `~/.claude/org/registry.json` — defines agent metadata: `department`, `reportsTo`, `tier` (leadership/engineer), `title`, `status`, `level`, `model` (opus/sonnet/haiku)
- **Department/phase source**: `~/.claude/org/departments.json` — defines org structure: departments with `head`, `color`, `label`, `order`

### 4. **Current Grouping**
- **By department**: Agents grouped in columns, department head pinned first (line 171-178), then sorted by tier/level (lines 174-177)
- **Hierarchy**: Single top leader (Rex) with no `reportsTo`, everyone else assigned to departments (line 188)
- **Model badges**: Orange/purple/blue tags per model type (lines 61-65, 315-322)
- **Role tags**: "LEADERSHIP" vs "ADVISOR" determined by `tier` field (line 305)
